children: The White House is planning to scale back its use of “special government employees,” the Wall Street Journal reported on Saturday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The designation allows individuals to work for the federal government but potentially avoid disclosure rules about conflicts of interest and finances that apply to regular government employees.
White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller has told associates that he wants to wind down the use of the designation, which is commonly abbreviated as SGE, the newspaper reported.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report. The White House did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
